description: ACE shared conformance vectors (2026-10-27 revision). Generated by scripts/generate-vectors.py; see each section's rules.

encoding.rules: base64: decode 'text' as canonical Base64 (valid => bytes == hex). canonicalJson: parse 'input' with the SDK's strict JSON reader and serialize with canonicalStateBytes; the UTF-8 result equals 'canonical', or (error: true) reading, the JSON-value check or serializing fails. wireInts: parse 'json'; the wire-integer reading is 'value' (null = rejected). identifiers: each predicate (02 § Identifiers; caip10/caip19 per 04 and profiles/commerce.md). httpsUrls: the ACE HTTPS URL grammar. relayUrls: normalizeRelayUrl. blockedAddresses: isBlockedAddress. conversationKey: both argument orders give 'key'.

canonicalJson.name: unpaired low surrogate in a key

signing.rules: encodePayload(fields) == hex. message: M = encodePayload('ace.v1', aceId, decimal(timestamp), seqOrEmpty, payload) == messageHex, with seqOrEmpty empty when seq is null (a KEL event signature) and decimal(seq) otherwise. actionSeparation: ML-DSA-65 verify of 'signature' over messageHex under agents[signer]'s signing key with ctx = each listed action gives its boolean. The second entry signs credential-shaped claims (the same shape as a delivery permit's) with ctx 'delegation': only the context distinguishes the two objects.

kel.rules: valid: verifyKel(agents[agent].kel[0:events or all], now) gives aceId, seq, lastHash, rootScheme, next, the signing delegation {seq, notAfter} (null when none) and isUsable(state, now). invalid: verifyKel(kel, now) fails with 'error' (rule 1 structure is checked for the whole log before any signature). eventBytes: canonical bytes of each event. forks: extendKel(pinned ? verifyKel(pinned, now) : null, candidate, now) gives 'outcome' and the resulting state's seq, or fails with 'error'. operational: 01 § Operational signatures rules 1-5 for 'signature' over M(agents[signer].aceId, timestamp, signature.seq, payload) with ctx 'action' against verifyKel(agents[signer].kel, now), the signer usable at 'now' (rule 5): error null = valid.

xwing.rules: draft-connolly-cfrg-xwing-kem-11 Appendix C vectors 1-3: public key from seed; decapsulate(ciphertext, seed) == sharedSecret; implementations with derandomized encapsulation also check encapsulate(publicKey, eseed) == (sharedSecret, ciphertext).

packet.rules: deterministic: header = encodePayload('ace.v1.packet', from, to, messageId, decimal(timestamp), prekeyId, kemCiphertext) == headerHex; key = HKDF-SHA256(ikm = ss, salt = saltHex (empty), info = header, L = 32) == keyHex; payload = nonce || AES-256-GCM(key, nonce, plaintext, aad = header) == payloadHex; createPacket with the injected (sharedSecret, kemCiphertext, nonce) reproduces packet.encryption exactly; signPayloadHex = encodePayload(to, messageId, prekeyId, kemCiphertext, payload) and messageHex = M(from, timestamp, seq, signPayload), over which packet.signature verifies against agents.alice with ctx 'packet'. Padding (03 § Encryption): contentHex = canonical JSON of 'content'; plaintextHex = pad(content) = u32be(len(content)) || content || zero bytes up to bucket(len(content) + 4), where bucket(n) = the smallest power of two >= max(n, 4096) for n <= 2^20, else 1179652 (MAX_PLAINTEXT_BYTES + 4); BUCKETS = {4096, 8192, ..., 1048576, 1179652}. The receiver unpads: len(pt) in BUCKETS, n = u32be(pt[0:4]) <= 1179648, 4 + n <= len(pt), bucket(n + 4) == len(pt), pt[4+n:] all zero, else invalid_body; the content is pt[4:4+n]. The 'length prefix past the plaintext' case is distinguishable only by the explicit 4 + n <= len(pt) check (an implementation that slices past the end also fails at content parsing); the 'bucket mismatch' case holds valid content, so only the bucket(n + 4) == len(pt) check rejects it. 'content.prekey' is the peer prekey alice offers bob (04 § Peer prekeys). The receiver vault holds prekeySeed (agents.bob's current prekey). decode: decodePacket on 'packet' (or on the parse of 'json') fails with 'error' or succeeds (null); the decoded payload length minus 28 (nonce + tag) must be in BUCKETS (invalid_packet). open: decode -> to must be agents[recipient] (wrong_recipient) -> operational signature against verifyKel(agents[sender].kel, now), the sender usable at now -> window now-604800 <= ts <= now+300 -> decrypt with the vault, passing the sender (unknown_prekey, decryption_failed) -> unpad (invalid_body) -> private content (invalid_body); 'error' null means it opens. An optional 'peerSeeds' {aceId: seedHex} means the receiver vault also holds, for each aceId, that seed as the peer prekey it offered that peer (peers[aceId].offered = {seed, offeredAt: the vectors' top-level now}, inUse and held null): it opens a packet from that aceId naming its ID (sha256 of its public key), and is unknown_prekey for any other sender.

privateContent.rules: decodePrivateContent(UTF-8 'text' or hex-decoded 'hex'; the content after unpadding) fails with 'error' (always invalid_body) or succeeds (null). Content is the closed object {type, schemaDigest, threadId?, body, prekey, admission?}: 'prekey' is required on every packet (receipts and contacts too) and is the canonical Base64 of a 1216-byte X-Wing public key (04 § Peer prekeys).

descriptor.rules: verifyPublishedAgent(publishedAgent, now) with production settings (no loopback relays). valid: succeeds and the live delegations' issuers are 'delegations' (in order). invalid: fails with 'error'. pinned: verify with the verifier's pin verifyKel(agents[pinned].kel, now): the carried KEL is reconciled with the pin (fork rules) and the signature must verify under the resulting newest state ('error' null = valid). A PeerStore/importAgent adopting these must behave the same.

replay.rules: 06 § Deduplication. Start from ReplayDetector(capacity, horizon) or fromState(initialState, capacity). classify: 'duplicate' if (sender, messageId) is held, else 'replay_horizon' if timestamp <= H or <= H[sender], else 'new'. commit(messageId, sender, timestamp, floor) returns 'expect'. Afterwards exportState() equals finalState (canonical JSON).

commerce.rules: profiles/commerce.md. transitions: a fresh thread store per case for the local party agents.alice (buyer) or agents.bob (seller); the third party is agents.carol. For each step, run the commerce rule check then commit for event {direction: receive when 'from' is not local else send, messageId, from, to, timestamp, type, threadId} and body (already schema-valid): the resulting thread state equals 'expect', or check fails with the code 'expect' and nothing changes. ext: validateCommerceExt accepts iff 'valid' (invalid_authorization). sender (08 § Sender state and busy threads): an Outbox for agents.alice with commerceRules, peer agents.bob, clock now + step index. Ops: send = enqueue(to bob, type, body, threadId (default t1), messageId); receipt = apply a receipt from bob {messageId, outcome, code?}; abandon = abandon(messageId) (the entry becomes expired: outcome unknown, a later receipt still settles it); receive = an inbound message from bob at pipeline step 10 (timestamp = clock): thread_busy if the Outbox reports thread t1 busy towards bob, else commerce check then commit. 'expect' is 'ok' or the error code; after each step the thread t1 state (null = no thread) and whether t1 is busy towards bob equal 'state' and 'busy'.

pipeline.rules: 06 § Receive pipeline. For each case a fresh receiver agents[receiver] whose vault holds packet.deterministic.prekeySeed as its published current prekey and, for an optional 'peerSeeds' {aceId: seedHex}, each seed as the peer prekey offered to that aceId (peers[aceId].offered = {seed, offeredAt: the vectors' top-level now}; same meaning as packet.open), whose own card record has contact 'contact' (open or closed), whose seen store has capacity 'capacity', and which has pinned and admitted each 'admitted' PublishedAgent (verified at the vectors' 'now'). Run the steps in order, each at clock 'now': processing 'packet' ends in 'disposition' (delivered, duplicate, drop or reject) with record code 'code' (null on success), and the receiver sends a receipt whose outcome is 'receipt', or none (null). Receipts and contact requests are never receipted (a replayed receipt is a duplicate like any packet); a packet beyond the replay horizon is dropped with record code replay_horizon and no receipt. Every content carries 'prekey' (the key the sender offers the receiver); the receiver strips it before validation. After step 6 opens a packet under the key offered to its sender, that key becomes the sender's in-use key (used(from, prekeyId, now)). An optional 'vaultAfter' {peer: aceId, inUse: prekeyId} is the receiver vault after the last step: peers[peer].inUse is that key, the key offered to peer (if any; a receipt to peer offers a fresh one) is a different one, and open(inUse, sender = peer) still succeeds (unknown_prekey for any other sender). Its optional 'held' {publicKey, timestamp} is the holder rule's record for peer: the content prekey of peer's newest packet and that packet's timestamp; held(peer, pin, now) returns that key, where pin is the receiver's pin for peer = lastHash of verifyKel(admitted[name of peer].kel, the vectors' top-level now) (the digest of the peer's last KEL event).

auth.rules: 07 § Authentication. cases: the action payload (02 § Signing actions) of 'request' == payloadHex; encodePayload(audience, nonce, payload) == authPayloadHex; M(agents[agent].aceId, timestamp, seq, authPayload) == messageHex, over which X-ACE-Signature verifies with ctx = the action; a relay verifying 'headers' for 'request' at clock = timestamp with its own audience accepts them. negative: a relay holding agents[agent]'s KEL, verifying 'headers' for 'request' at clock 'now' with audience https://relay.example, fails with 'error' (checks in 07 order). registration: the RegistrationRequest verifies at clock 'now' for 'audience'; payloadHex = encodePayload(lastHashHex, audience); messageHex = M(aceId, timestamp, seq, payload); the idempotency digest is requestDigest = SHA-256(M); each 'negative' entry (request, audience, now) fails with its 'error' (07 § Registration steps 1-5). wake: each 'valid' body is a well-formed PUT /v1/wake request {gateway, token} (07 § Wake hints) that a client sends; each 'invalid' body is refused before signing and by a relay with invalid_argument. A wake request with no gateway is DELETE /v1/wake with an empty payload.

relayErrors.rules: Map a relay response that is not the call's expected success (status, headers, raw body) to an ACEError: 'code', its 'category', the relay 'error' string ('relayCode', null if absent) and 'retryAfterSeconds' (only for transient codes, only delay-seconds; null otherwise). The error's status equals 'status'.
